profile.headline: Software Engineer at Beam Benefits
profile.summary:
I came to software from an unexpected place: recruiting. I've always liked helping people and figuring out how things work, so I started teaching myself to code on the side. That hobby turned into the goal of doing it for a living. I went through Tech Elevator's bootcamp and have been building software ever since.
 
Today I'm a full-stack Software Engineer at Beam Benefits, building customer-facing web apps with React, TypeScript, and Ruby on Rails. The work I like most is the kind that quietly makes people's lives easier. I use AI-assisted development (Claude Code is part of my daily workflow), and I'm always up for connecting with other engineers and people building useful things.

positions.title: IS Systems Programmer
positions.description:
-Designed and developed software enhancements for multiple customer-facing applications
-Developed improvements for a web application used by NICU nurses to combine data from 14 repositories into one location 
-Developed features and fixed bugs for an application used by Interpreters to manage their appointments with their patients 
-Assisted in the analysis and interpretation of customer needs

positions.title: Student
positions.description:
Attended a 14-week .NET coding bootcamp to learn how to develop dynamic web-based software systems using the .NET programming language and platform including:

-Object-Oriented Programming: C#, .NET
-Web Application Development: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ASP.NET MVC, IIS Express, Vue.js
-Database Programming: ADO.NET, Table Design, SQL, MS SQL, E/R diagrams
-Development tools and techniques: Agile, Unit Testing (MS Test), TDD, Git Bash, Visual Studio 2017

positions.title: Associate Recruiter
positions.description:
-Reviewed all resumes and conducted phone screening/online application assessments for potential interview
-Conducted interviews for 50+ candidates weekly at interview events then collaborated with Recruitment team to select New Hires
-Distributed Offer Letters for New Hires and maintained candidate pool/metrics
-Maintained the job postings and job templates for all open positions on our company website as well as our Applicant Tracking system
